title: Jamaican Jerk Jamaican Ground Beef Burger
description: This Jamaican-inspired burger features a flavorful ground beef patty seasoned with allspice, topped with a tangy slaw and served on a toasted iron teppan panini press.
instructions: Prepare the jerky seasoning mixture by combining 1 tablespoon of brown sugar, 1 teaspoon of ground allspice, and 1/4 teaspoon of cayenne pepper in a small bowl.
Add 2 teaspoons of the jerk seasoning mixture to the ground beef and mix until just combined.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
Brush the iron teppan panini press with cooking spray and add patties.
Broil for 5 minutes or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the hamburger buns on the stovetop until lightly browned.
Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of vegan mayo on the bottom bun, followed by a beef patty, a lettuce leaf, a tomato slice, and finally the top bun.
Make the slaw by combining shredded red cabbage and vegan mayo in a small bowl and refrigerating until ready to serve.
